paper_title: Incorporating Domain Knowledge into Materials Tokenization
caption: Comparison of Macro-F1 scores for MATTER and w/o material knowledge across during tokenization training different number of tokens.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates how Macro-F1 score varies with the number of tokens during tokenization training for two methods, “MATTER (ours)” and “w/o material information,” with each line accompanied by a semi-transparent shaded band around it. The x-axis is labeled “Number of tokens,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 0.5 to 1.5, with regularly spaced tick labels shown at 0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.2, and 1.4 (interval 0.2). The y-axis is labeled “Macro-F1 Score (%),” uses a linear scale, and ranges approximately from 47 to 59, with labeled ticks at 48, 50, 52, 54, 56, and 58 (interval 2). The MATTER (ours) series is drawn as a solid pink line with circular markers, starting near 55.1% at 0.5 tokens, dipping slightly around 54.3–54.5% at 0.6–0.7, rising to about 57.0% at 0.8 and reaching its highest point near 57.9% at 1.0, then declining through about 55.4% (1.1) and ~53.0% (1.2) to ~52.6% (1.3), increasing to ~53.5% at 1.4, and ending near 50.9% at 1.5. The “w/o material information” series is shown as a solid purple line with circular markers, beginning around 52.5% at 0.5, increasing to about 54.1% at 0.7, then staying near 52.8–53.3% from roughly 0.8 through 1.2 (e.g., ~53.3% at 0.8–0.9 and ~52.4% at 1.2), dipping to about 51.7% at 1.3, rising to ~53.3% at 1.4, and then dropping to approximately 47.9% at 1.5.
